status.main_product: Drones, drone software (SkyDeck), and drone-as-a-service solutions
status.scope_reason: The company provides full-stack commercial drone-as-a-service platforms, aerial mapping, and agricultural analytics under its own name.
status.evidence: According to a March 2026 report by Startup Pedia, Asteria Aerospace is an active drone technology firm acquired by Reliance Industries in 2019 that provides commercial services such as aerial mapping and agricultural analytics.

claims.claim: The company reports having over 750 drones deployed across diverse fields including defence, homeland security, GIS, oil and gas, agriculture, construction, and mining.

The company's diverse product and fleet lineup consists of multirotor systems (such as the micro-category A200, A200-XT, and small-category A410-XT) as well as the AT-15 vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) blended-wing hybrid platform.
claims.corrected: The company's diverse product and fleet lineup consists of multirotor systems (such as the micro-category A200, small-category A200-XT, and small-category A410-XT) as well as the AT-15 vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) blended-wing hybrid platform.
claims.source: Asteria Aerospace Product Documentation (https://www.asteria.co.in/industries/industrial-security-drone-solutions and official A200-XT specifications show it belongs to the small category, whereas the original A200 belongs to the micro category)

claims.claim: The company reports designing and manufacturing its own proprietary drone platforms ranging from 2 kg to 25 kg, utilizing in-house flight controller technology and physical airframe designs.
claims.source: Asteria Aerospace Executive Interviews & Times of India Feature (https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/asteria-innovating-in-drones-with-ai-5g-cloud/articleshow/99775851.cms)

claims.claim: Asteria Aerospace Limited secured independent third-party validation by obtaining multiple official Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) type certifications for its indigenously designed models, including the A200, A200-XT, and A410-XT platforms.

In a completed partnership with Ambuja Neotia, Asteria Aerospace deployed its full-stack drone solutions to process high-resolution imagery into orthomosaics, contour maps, and digital surface models, simulating a 70-year flood scenario to optimize site layout design.
claims.note: The exact duration of '70-year flood scenario' is unconfirmed in published project materials, though a 70-year timeline for flood risk modeling or simulating waterlogging is noted.
claims.source: Asteria Aerospace Case Studies & Autonomy Global Event Highlights (https://www.asteria.co.in/news-and-media/autonomy-global)

claims.claim: Asteria Aerospace Limited was granted India's first micro category drone type certification from the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) under the Drone Rules 2021 for its indigenously designed A200 multirotor drone.
claims.source: Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) via Asteria Aerospace Press Release

claims.claim: The Ministry of Civil Aviation granted Asteria Aerospace conditional exemption to act as one of 20 selected consortia authorized to conduct experimental Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) drone flights in a sandboxed environment.
claims.source: Ministry of Civil Aviation (Press Information Bureau)

claims.claim: Asteria Aerospace Limited secured a ₹59.72 lakh contract on January 4, 2024, from the Ministry of Coal to deliver Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) solutions.
claims.corrected: Asteria Aerospace Limited secured a ₹50.61 lakh contract on January 4, 2024, from the Ministry of Coal to deliver Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) solutions.
claims.source: Ministry of Coal Tender Records via Tenderkart

claims.claim: According to Registrar of Companies (RoC) financial statements, Asteria Aerospace Limited reported an operating revenue of ₹78.7 crore in FY25, representing a 90% increase from ₹41.6 crore in FY24.
claims.source: Registrar of Companies (RoC) financial statements via Startup Pedia

claims.claim: The company's revenue from services (such as aerial mapping and agricultural analytics) stood at ₹47 lakh in FY25, decreasing from ₹5.32 crore in FY24, while its overall net loss widened to ₹6.7 crore in FY25 from ₹2 crore in FY24.
claims.source: Registrar of Companies (RoC) financial statements via Startup Pedia

claims.claim: The company reports that its robust drone solutions are designed to operate in diverse Indian environments, ranging from altitudes of 6,000 meters above sea level in the northern Himalayan mountains at sub-zero temperatures down to desert and jungle regions.
claims.source: Asteria Aerospace official website (news and media section)

claims.claim: Asteria Aerospace Limited announced a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Drone Destination Limited to jointly develop international drone sales and services business, leveraging Drone Destination's fleet and pilots alongside Asteria Aerospace's SkyDeck data analytics platform.
claims.note: The specific utilization of the 'SkyDeck' platform was not mentioned in official announcements; the announcements mention using AAL's/Asteria's technology platform for data processing, analytics, and visualization without specifying SkyDeck by name.
claims.source: Times of India report and Drone Destination press statements via Aviation & Space India

claims.claim: Reliance Industries Limited acquired a majority strategic stake in Asteria Aerospace Limited through its subsidiary Reliance Strategic Business Ventures Limited, providing a structural alliance with India's largest private-sector conglomerate to accelerate go-to-market solutions across security, energy, telecom, and agriculture.
claims.source: Reliance Industries Limited regulatory filing and official press release via Moneycontrol

status.scope_reason: The company provides on-demand agricultural drone spraying services directly to external clients via its application framework.
status.evidence: According to Tracxn, Leher was founded in 2023 in Gurugram and operates a platform providing drone-based agricultural spraying services.

claims.claim: The company reports operating its spraying and precision agriculture services using a mix of company-owned drones and localized partner fleets, having executed spraying operations across more than 35,000 acres for over 2,100 farmers.

The company reports utilizing multi-rotor agricultural spraying drones equipped with 10-liter liquid tanks, 30,000 mAh solid-state Li-ion batteries, and flat-fan or centrifugal nozzle configurations supporting flow rates of 3 to 5 liters per minute.

The company operates primarily as a platform and service aggregator that connects farmers with trained DGCA-certified drone pilots and existing drone fleets, rather than developing proprietary drone hardware.
The company reports offering DGCA-approved drone pilot training programs for individuals looking to start certified careers in the drone industry.
The company reports providing "CoverageView Reports" for tea estate managers, which deliver detailed post-operation operational visibility regarding where, what, and how much area was sprayed.
The company reports offering a DGCA-approved Drone Pilot Training program to individuals seeking certified agricultural drone careers.
The company reports managing backend drone licensing and pre-approved spray routes via the Digital Sky platform as part of its onboarding bundle for drone partners.
claims.note: managing backend drone licensing and pre-approved spray routes via the Digital Sky platform as part of its onboarding bundle

claims.claim: The company reports that its platform has completed drone crop spraying across more than 35,000 acres of land, serving over 2,100 farmers and collaborating with more than 100 drone entrepreneurs.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its platform has completed drone crop spraying across more than 30,000 acres of land, serving over 2,100 farmers and collaborating with more than 100 drone entrepreneurs.

claims.claim: The company reports serving over 6,500 acres and securing its first funding round in 2024, expanding its cumulative metrics on its official platform to state that it has sprayed over 30,000 acres.
The company reports having sprayed over 35,000 acres across India, partnering with over 2,200 drone operators to serve smallholder farmers, cooperatives, and estates.

The company reports running the Leher Drone Partner Programme, a full-stack system that empowers rural entrepreneurs (Village Level Entrepreneurs) to operate as third-party drone entrepreneurs and deliver mechanized agricultural spraying services directly to farmers.

The company reports providing dedicated drone services and coordinated bulk spraying scheduling for external institutional demand channels, including Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), agribusiness contractors, large farms, and corporate plantation estates.

The company reports that its platform has enabled the spraying of over 35,000 acres across India and has partnered with over 2,200 drone operators to provide services to smallholder farmers, cooperatives, and estates.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its platform has enabled the spraying of over 30,000 acres across India and has partnered with over 100 drone partners and more than 2,100 trained operators to provide services to smallholder farmers, cooperatives, and estates.

claims.claim: The company has facilitated agricultural drone spraying services across northern India, registering institutional demand channels and enabling a network of rural entrepreneurs ("drone-walas") who receive training and certification support through its Drone Partner Program.
